name: Tyroon Tea Company Limited
about: Tyroon Tea Company Limited engages in the cultivation, manufacture, and sale of tea in India. It offers CTC and orthodox teas. The company's tea estate has an aggregate grant area of 922 hectares, wherein 680 hectares is under tea cultivation located in the Jorhat district of Assam. The company was incorporated in 1890 and is based in Kolkata, India.
